protocol.scheme: diagonal: variant v evaluated on batch v, one process each (D18 + D31)
protocol.comment: D31 uniform-slice protocol: 10 processes x 20 episodes = 200 episodes over batches 0-9, so every arm -- flat or per-variant -- has the same spatial coverage AND the same process warm-up state. Supersedes the mixed 100-episode/diagonal protocol for the cells it covers.
